name: Gentle Glow Foaming Cleanser 150ml
how_to_use: Morning and night on damp skin, massage 30 seconds, rinse.

name: Cream Cloud Hydrating Cleanser 150ml
how_to_use: Morning and night, massage onto dry or damp skin, rinse with lukewarm water.

name: Even Tone Niacinamide 10% Serum 30ml
how_to_use: 3–4 drops after cleansing, morning and night, before moisturiser.
caution: Patch-test first. Mild tingling for the first few days is normal.

name: Clear Path 2% Salicylic Serum 30ml
how_to_use: Every other night after cleansing, then moisturiser. Build up to nightly.
caution: Not for pregnancy. Patch-test first. Always use sunscreen during the day.

name: Bright Days Vitamin C 15% Serum 30ml
how_to_use: 3 drops in the morning after cleansing, then sunscreen.
caution: Patch-test first. Keep the bottle closed and away from heat.

name: Night Renew 0.3% Retinol Serum 30ml
how_to_use: Night only, 2 nights a week to start, after cleansing. Always use sunscreen the next day.
caution: Not for pregnancy or breastfeeding. Patch-test first. Expect some dryness in the first 2 weeks.

name: Barrier Balm Ceramide Moisturiser 50ml
how_to_use: Morning and night as the last step before sunscreen.

name: Sheer Shield SPF 50 Sunscreen 50ml (no white cast)
how_to_use: Two finger-lengths every morning as the last step. Reapply every 2–3 hours outdoors.

name: Starter Routine Set (cleanser, niacinamide serum, gel moisturiser, SPF 50)
how_to_use: Morning: cleanser, serum, moisturiser, SPF. Night: cleanser, serum, moisturiser.
